title: Problem
问题
html:
Label-free RLVR often treats the most frequent answer sampled from a policy as a pseudo-label. On hard problems, that majority can be confidently wrong; repeatedly rewarding it collapses exploration and reinforces a dominant but spurious mode.

This paper asks whether the model can create a less brittle learning signal from its own rollouts, without an external judge or gold labels. It tests a two-stage vote that asks whether an answer remains supported after the model distribution is deliberately perturbed.

无标签 RLVR 常把同一策略采样中出现最多的答案当作伪标签。难题上，多数答案也可能自信地错；持续奖励它会压缩探索，并把模型锁进看似稳定却错误的主导模式。

本文要回答的是：不借助外部裁判或金标，模型能否只利用自身 rollout 产生更可靠的学习信号？作者检验一种两阶段投票：当模型分布被有意扰动后，一个答案是否仍能得到支持。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DCRL treats agreement as a robustness test rather than a simple popularity count. The current policy first acts as an anchor and samples its ordinary dominant answers. A temporary copy then takes one unlearning step that suppresses high-confidence tokens, becoming an explorer that samples alternative trajectories. Candidate answers are scored by the harmonic mean of their anchor and explorer frequencies, so a choice needs support both in the ordinary distribution and after it is flattened. The elected answer receives reward 1, the anchor-only majority retains 0.5, and others receive 0; a consensus-rate gate decides when exploratory rollouts enter GRPO updates. The method uses no external model or label during training, but it still assumes the two distributions do not share the same wrong prior.

DCRL 不把一致性仅仅当作票数，而把它当成一次稳健性检验。当前策略先作为锚点，采样正常分布下的主导答案；再复制出临时探索器，通过一次遗忘步压低高置信 token 的概率，从被扰平的分布采样替代轨迹。候选答案按两组频率的调和均值排序，只有在正常分布和扰动后分布中都获得支持，才会成为伪标签。该答案得 1 分，仅符合锚点多数的答案保留 0.5 分，其余为 0；共识率再决定何时把探索轨迹纳入 GRPO 更新。训练不使用外部模型或标签，但仍假定两个分布不会共享同一个错误先验。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Sample an anchor. The current policy draws (G) ordinary rollouts for a prompt and records its majority answer and consensus rate.
  1. Make an explorer. A copy takes one clipped unlearning gradient step that suppresses high-probability anchor tokens; the original policy is unchanged. The explorer draws another (G) rollouts.
  1. Elect a pseudo-label. For every candidate final answer, compute the harmonic mean of its anchor and explorer frequencies; select the maximum.
  1. Assign rewards. A trajectory matching the elected answer receives 1; one matching only the anchor majority receives 0.5; all others receive 0.
  1. Update adaptively. GRPO always uses anchor samples; explorer samples join the gradient only when the moving consensus rate exceeds one half. The main runs train Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Qwen3-4B-Base, and Qwen3-8B-Base for two epochs on DAPO-Math-14K.

1. 采样锚点。 当前策略对一个提示生成 (G) 条常规 rollout，记录多数答案和共识率。
  1. 构造探索器。 复制模型做一次带裁剪的遗忘梯度步，压低锚点中高概率 token；原策略参数不变。探索器再生成 (G) 条 rollout。
  1. 选出伪标签。 对每个候选最终答案，计算其在锚点与探索器中的频率调和均值，取最大者。
  1. 分配奖励。 命中伪标签的轨迹得 1；只命中锚点多数答案的得 0.5；其余为 0。
  1. 自适应更新。 GRPO 始终使用锚点样本；移动共识率超过二分之一时，探索器样本才进入梯度。主实验在 DAPO-Math-14K 上训练两轮，覆盖 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct、Qwen3-4B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base。

title: Evidence
证据
html: On DAPO-Math-14K, DCRL’s Qwen3-8B average across eight benchmarks is 50.9, above the label-free TTRL baseline’s 50.2 but below gold-label GRPO’s 53.5. Its MATH-500 score is 79.2 versus 78.3 for TTRL and 82.0 for GRPO. The ablation on the same model lowers the five-benchmark average from 56.3 to 56.0 without harmonic election, 55.4 without the conservative reward, and 53.4 without dynamic sampling. Test-time adaptation also exceeds TTRL on the reported four datasets, but the results remain an author-run comparison rather than evidence that pseudo-label errors are eliminated.

在 DAPO-Math-14K 上，Qwen3-8B 的八基准平均分为 50.9，高于无标签 TTRL 的 50.2，但低于使用金标的 GRPO 的 53.5；MATH-500 分别为 79.2、78.3 和 82.0。同一模型的消融中，五基准平均分从完整方法的 56.3 降至：去掉调和选举后 56.0、去掉保守奖励后 55.4、去掉动态采样后 53.4。报告的测试时适应也在四个数据集上超过 TTRL，但这仍是作者运行的比较，不能证明伪标签错误已被消除。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Rather than treating a policy’s ordinary majority vote as truth, the method asks whether the answer survives a deliberately flattened version of that same policy. The harmonic election links exploitation and exploration, while the 0.5 reserve reward and adaptive sampling keep exploration from immediately dominating the update. This is a different intervention from adding an external verifier or more samples; it targets a specific failure of self-generated consensus. It does not solve shared model blind spots, because both distributions can still agree on the same wrong answer.
它不把普通策略的多数票直接视为真值，而是追问：同一个策略被刻意扰平后，这个答案是否仍能站得住。调和选举把利用与探索连起来，0.5 的保守奖励和动态采样则避免探索信号立刻主导更新。这不同于增加外部验证器或单纯扩大采样数，针对的是自生成共识的一类失效。它不能解决共享盲点：两个分布仍可能赞同同一个错误答案。

title: Limitations
局限
html: If anchor and explorer share a wrong prior, dual consensus provides no corrective signal and can reinforce the error. On tasks far outside pretraining, the explorer may not discover a useful alternative path. Each update also needs two rollout groups and a temporary gradient step, increasing cost and making outcomes sensitive to answer extraction, probability clipping, and the consensus threshold. The training data are described as DAPO-Math-14K, but label-free reward construction should not be confused with proving that all data curation or evaluation is label-free.
若锚点和探索器共享同一个错误先验，双共识没有纠错信号，反而可能强化错误。任务远离预训练分布时，探索器也未必能找到有价值的替代路径。每次更新还需要两组 rollout 和一次临时梯度步，成本更高，并对答案抽取、概率裁剪和共识阈值敏感。训练数据写作 DAPO-Math-14K；奖励不使用标签，并不等于数据整理或评测的每一环都已经证明“无标签”。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use DCRL when a reasoning dataset has prompts but no trustworthy executable verifier or gold answer for online reward. Log the two answer distributions, elected pseudo-label, agreement rate, and final-answer extraction so that reward failures can be audited rather than hidden behind a single score. For deployment, compare it against majority vote and a supervised verifier on held-out tasks; if both anchor and explorer agree incorrectly, add an independent source of feedback instead of expecting self-consensus to repair the mistake.
当推理数据只有提示、却没有可信可执行验证器或在线金标时，可用 DCRL 设计无标签奖励实验。应保存两组答案分布、选出的伪标签、共识率和最终答案抽取过程，让奖励失效能被审计，而不是被单一分数掩盖。部署前要在未见任务上同时比较多数投票、DCRL 和有监督验证器；若锚点与探索器一起答错，应引入独立反馈，而非期待自共识自行纠正。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. The central comparison is two-stage agreement versus ordinary majority vote, not unsupervised learning versus a fully controlled gold-label setting.
  1. Reproduce the temporary unlearning update, clipping rule, answer extractor, group size, and moving consensus window; each can change the pseudo-label.
  1. Keep the 0.5 reserve reward separate from the elected reward when logging advantages and ablations.
  1. The reported benchmark protocol uses 16 samples per question at temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95, averaged over 16 independent seeds.
  1. Evaluate a shared-wrong-prior stress set; success on ordinary agreement rates does not demonstrate escape from a correlated error.

1. 核心比较是两阶段一致性与普通多数投票，而不是“无监督”与完全受控金标训练的简单对比。
  1. 复现必须固定临时遗忘更新、裁剪规则、答案抽取器、组大小和移动共识窗口；它们都会改变伪标签。
  1. 记录优势函数和消融时，要把 0.5 的保守奖励与被选中答案的奖励分开。
  1. 报告的基准协议是每题采样 16 次，温度 0.6、top-p 0.95，并对 16 个独立随机种子取平均。
  1. 应专门测试“两个分布共享错误先验”的压力集；普通一致率高不代表能够逃离相关性错误。
